messages:
auditor_micah: Morning — need SOC 2 / ISO fieldwork evidence for the recent RBAC cleanup (PR #7991) and the KMS rotation on 2026-03-20. Deliverables: role-diff + approver trail, auth logs for the rollout window (48h preferred, 90d if trivial), KMS rotation manifest & DescribeKey outputs, sample encrypted object list (ETag + encryption-context), proof old key cannot decrypt new ciphertexts, vuln triage link + postmortem summary.

devops_olivia: Olivia from DevOps. I can collect the git diff and PR metadata. We removed the clusterrole `cluster-admin-readonly` and narrowed verbs on the svc-account. Which log window should we prioritize?

auditor_micah: 90d is ideal for SOC 2, but 48h around the change is acceptable if you include full change history and approver audit trail. Checksums required for every artifact.

sec_maya: Maya (Security). We will produce a GPG-signed manifest, md5/sha256 for each file, and a README with the exact commands used to generate artifacts. Confirming no emergency workarounds were used during the rollout.

oncall_ben: Oncall here. Splunk/SIEM export for auth proxy and CloudTrail will be created. Example Splunk query I used: `index=auth_proxy (action=role.bind OR action=role.update) earliest=-48h latest=now | table _time, user, action, resource, request_id` Export path (temporary presigned): https://s3-presigned.example/alpha-auth-170 & expires in 7d.

evidence_bot: presigned URLs created: https://s3-presigned.example/alpha-auth-170 (auth logs), https://s3-presigned.example/beta-kms-7991 (kms manifest). All links valid for 7 days.

devops_olivia: Role diff command we'll attach: `git diff --no-color origin/main~2..origin/main -- roles/` PR snapshot: https://go.redwood/pr/7991. Approvers recorded: @alex (2026-03-19T15:12:10Z), @maya (2026-03-19T15:20:02Z).

sec_maya: KMS rotation executed 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z. Rotation manifest path: /evidence/kms/rotation-2026-03-20.json (sha256: f1e2d3c4b5...). We'll include DescribeKey output for both old and new key ARNs and the CloudTrail KMS event bundle for the rotation window.

devops_olivia: For sampling we will include 12 objects with: object key, S3 ETag, encryption-context (e.g., purpose=re-encrypt, service=inference, rotation=2026-03-20). We will also include an object list CSV and checksums.

devops_olivia: Example decrypt test we'll include in the package: 

```
# attempt decrypt with OLD key - expected to fail
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sample.obj1.enc --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/old-key-arn || echo "decrypt failed as expected"

# decrypt with NEW key - expected to succeed
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sample.obj1.enc --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/new-key-arn
```

sec_maya: We'll also provide automated unit test output showing old-key decryption returns an error, new-key decryption returns plaintext and the ETag changed (ciphertext differs). This demonstrates no plaintext copies were left behind during re-encryption.

auditor_micah: Need an explicit chain-of-custody: who ran the rotation (service account), who approved the RBAC PR, timestamps for both artifact generation and approvals, and a clear statement that no manual credential resets or emergency hotpatches occurred.

devops_olivia: Rotation operator: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/kms-rotate-bot. Approvers as above. No emergency hotpatches; standard canary rollout used. Will add statement to signed manifest.

sec_maya: Vulnerability triage: CVE-2026-0901 impacted one runtime component. Patch deployed 2026-03-18, image rebuild and rolling deploy completed before the RBAC changes. Triage doc: https://go.redwood/triage/CVE-2026-0901. We'll include a short timeline excerpt in the manifest and link to the postmortem.

auditor_micah: Good. Please email the signed bundle to auditor.packages@redwood.com and include md5/sha256 for each artifact and a GPG signature. Also include instructions so an auditor can reproduce the decrypt-failure test locally.

sec_maya: ETA: full signed bundle + README + checksums in 48 hours. I'll DM presigned links when upload completes.

auditor_micah: Thanks — :thumbsup:
